insight: The user needs to be able to fully clear or delete the Editor content in one action, instead of the tool overwriting, appending to, or being unable to rebuild it.

core_insight: The user needs to be able to fully clear or delete the Editor content in one action, instead of the tool overwriting, appending to, or being unable to rebuild it.

insight: The user needs comments/annotations placed directly at the relevant location in the document, with a settable commenter name and clearer colour coding, for direct hand-off into Word.

core_insight: The user needs comments/annotations placed directly at the relevant location in the document, with a settable commenter name and clearer colour coding, for direct hand-off into Word.
